_note: 주간 이미지 자동 생성용 프롬프트 라이브러리. 제품 스펙은 쇼핑몰 상세페이지 실측값이다 (덤벨 16x4.5cm 1kg 2개입 + 엣지패턴 / 밴드 둘레 66·76·86cm 폭 8cm 3종 다른 길이). 형태를 바꿀 일이 있으면 반드시 상세페이지를 먼저 확인하고 여기를 고칠 것 — 즉석에서 지어내면 매번 반려된다.

shared.quality: Muted natural colour grading, premium lifestyle brand photography, shallow depth of field, realistic film-like grain. Do NOT add any yoga mat, rug or cork mat that is not described above.
shared.no_branding: ABSOLUTELY NO BRANDING: NO text, NO lettering, NO words, NO logo, NO wordmark, NO icon, NO pictogram and NO blurred smudge anywhere in the frame.
shared.person: Photorealistic documentary-style photograph shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens. A real Korean woman in her late twenties. Photographic skin with visible natural texture, fine pores, subtle unevenness - NOT smooth plastic skin, NOT airbrushed, NOT waxy, NOT a CGI mannequin. Hair tied in a low bun with a few natural loose strands, never covering the face. Wardrobe: a fitted charcoal-grey sports top with a racerback and visible flatlock seams, matching high-waisted leggings with a visible waistband seam, realistic stretch wrinkles and natural creases where the body bends. Natural realistic human proportions, barefoot.
shared.mat_body: LONG full-size rectangular yoga mat, roughly 3:1 length-to-width (180x61cm), lying COMPLETELY UNROLLED AND FLAT - NOT rolled, NOT half-rolled, NOT folded, NOT curled at either end. A THICK CUSHIONED mat about 8MM thick - the near long edge shows clear visible thickness like a firm dense cushion with a slim dark edge band, NOT a thin 2-3mm travel mat, NOT a fluffy pile rug. Suede-like matte microfibre top with a fine soft fabric texture so the print looks absorbed into the fabric.
shared.mat_artwork_rule: MAT ARTWORK SCALE - the repeated failure is drawing the shapes TOO SMALL. Fix it exactly like this: there are only THREE shapes on the whole mat and each one is ENORMOUS - as tall as the mat is wide, so it TOUCHES OR NEARLY TOUCHES BOTH LONG EDGES, leaving only a thin cream margin of a couple of centimetres at the top and bottom. The three shapes sit side by side down the length with narrow cream gaps between them and together they cover the mat almost end to end. DO NOT draw small circles floating in the middle of the mat with wide empty cream borders along the sides. Each shape is a big soft rounded blob with irregular watercolour edges and visible mottled paper-like texture - hand-painted, not a clean vector circle.
shared.mat_logo_offframe: FRAMING - KEEP THE BRANDED END OUT OF SHOT: the real mat carries a small printed wordmark near one short end. Compose so that end is cropped away by the frame edge, or is hidden behind the subject. Under no circumstances draw a wordmark, a logo, a monogram, a pictogram or any lettering onto the mat yourself - an invented mark is worse than no mark. The mat surface inside the frame carries printed artwork only.
shared.iphone: photo shot on iPhone, casual handheld snapshot, slightly tilted framing. True-to-life colours, realistic phone camera dynamic range - highlights near the window blow out a little and shadows crush a little, slight sensor noise, a touch of handheld imperfection. It should look like something the owner grabbed on the way past, not a shoot.
shared.iphone_negative: NOT staged, NOT a studio photo, NO professional lighting, NO softbox, NO seamless backdrop, NO product-catalogue look, NO perfectly centred composition, NO glossy retouching. NO text, NO lettering, NO wordmark, NO logo and NO blurred smudge of fake lettering anywhere in frame - an invented mark is worse than no mark, so keep any branded part of the product out of shot.
shared.mat_artwork_guard: MAT FRAMING RULE - the whole WIDTH of the mat and at least TWO THIRDS of its LENGTH must be inside the frame, so all of its printed shapes are recognisable together. Never fill the frame with a detail of the print alone: a crop that shows only part of the artwork makes the pattern unreliable.

mat_active_steps.label: 요가매트 Active steps
mat_active_steps.spec: Three huge watercolour shapes on a warm cream ground, in order along the length: (1) a PALE BLUE-GREY rounded blob; (2) a warm GOLDEN-YELLOW rounded blob, crossed by a VERTICAL brush stroke of deep TEAL-GREEN paint that runs ACROSS THE MAT'S WIDTH from the top edge downward, overlapping the yellow so the overlap turns deep olive-green; (3) a large DUSTY GREY-PURPLE blob, muted greyed-off mauve, more grey than violet - warm-toned, with more red in it than green; it is emphatically NOT blue, NOT sky-blue, NOT aqua, NOT teal and NOT grey-green. Each blob is as tall as the mat is wide.

mat_before_sunrise.label: 요가매트 Before sunrise
mat_before_sunrise.spec: On a cream ground: a deep NAVY-SLATE watercolour wash and soft APRICOT-PINK oval forms, with fine copper-orange line accents.

mat_warm_sunlight.label: 요가매트 Warm sunlight
mat_warm_sunlight.spec: On a cream ground: soft APRICOT-PINK oval forms, a warm YELLOW ring outline and a SLATE-NAVY block.

band.label: 힙업밴드 (3개입)
band.spec:
THE 3-PIECE SET IS THREE DIFFERENT DESIGNS AT THREE DIFFERENT LENGTHS - never three copies of one pattern and never three equal lengths. Real measured spec (circumference / flat length when laid down, all 8cm wide):
  (1) SHORTEST, flat about 33cm long: cream and warm beige ground with large TEAL-BLUE organic shapes at both ends, the most minimal of the three
  (2) MEDIUM, flat about 38cm long: deep NAVY and mid-blue ground with cream palm leaves and a muted brown shape
  (3) LONGEST, flat about 43cm long: cream ground with a big MUSTARD-YELLOW shape, brown palm fronds and a maroon circle
PROPORTION IS CRITICAL: each band is a SHORT CHUNKY STRIP, only about 4 to 5.5 times longer than it is wide (33-43cm long by 8cm wide). Do NOT draw them long and thin like ribbons or belts. Thick woven jacquard elastic with fine stitched edges; the inner face has fine silicone anti-slip lines. Each band carries a narrow BLACK fabric label wrapped around its MIDDLE, printed in small white with a minimal line-art dumbbell pictogram above the wordmark "Design:Gym". Soft floppy fabric - laid down it collapses into a FLAT two-layer strip with softly rounded folded ends; it can never stand up or hold a round hoop shape.

kettlebell_grey.label: 문 케틀벨 4.5kg (라이트그레이)
kettlebell_grey.spec: The outer body is a thick rounded disc whose BOTTOM IS CUT FLAT into a wide straight base so it stands on its own; a single LARGE CIRCULAR HOLE is set OFF-CENTRE, pushed UP and slightly to the upper-right, so material is THIN along the top-right rim and THICK along the bottom-left, forming a crescent of mass. One seamless moulded body, NO metal bell, NO separate looped handle, NO chain - the hole itself is the handle. Matte with a fine subtle pebbled texture. Colour is soft light warm grey, gently desaturated, NOT white, NOT charcoal, NOT beige or tan. ENGRAVED BADGE on the front face near the flat base: a shallow recessed oval plate carrying ONE line of text reading exactly "Design:Gym | 10LB | KETTLEBELL" in a very thin sans-serif, tone-on-tone slightly darker than the body, crisp and read normally left to right.

kettlebell_mint.label: 문 케틀벨 4.5kg (라이트민트)
kettlebell_mint.spec: Same shape as the grey moon kettlebell: thick rounded disc, BOTTOM CUT FLAT into a wide straight base, one LARGE OFF-CENTRE CIRCULAR HOLE pushed up and slightly right so the mass forms a crescent, one seamless moulded body with no metal bell and no separate handle. Matte finely pebbled surface. Colour is soft pale MINT green with a clearly visible gentle mint tint, not washed out to white. ENGRAVED BADGE near the flat base: shallow recessed oval plate reading exactly "Design:Gym | 10LB | KETTLEBELL" in a very thin tone-on-tone sans-serif, read normally left to right.

dumbbell_blue.label: 소프트 실리콘 모던 덤벨 1kg (라이트블루)
dumbbell_blue.spec: A PAIR of them (sold as a 2-piece set, 1kg each). Real measured spec: each one is 16cm long and 4.5cm across - a SLIM ELONGATED BAR roughly 3.5 times longer than it is thick, sized to be gripped in one closed hand with the rounded ends just peeking out past the fist. Do NOT render it short and stubby like a bar of soap. The form is a smooth stadium / capsule: fully semicircular ends, straight parallel long sides, gently domed on top, one seamless soft-silicone moulded piece with a soft satin sheen. THE SILHOUETTE IS CRITICAL - NO narrow middle, NO waist, NO pinch, NO grip bar, NO bulbous end weights: it is NOT a classic bone-shaped dumbbell, NOT two balls joined by a stick, NOT a flat paddle. NO metal, NO knurling, NO chrome. The surface is completely SMOOTH and uninterrupted - NO grooves, NO ribs, NO ridges, NO texture lines anywhere on the body or the sides. BRANDING - WORDMARK ONLY: "Design:Gym" printed SMALL in a soft muted grey, very thin sans-serif with wide letter-spacing, running ALONG the length near one end. That text is the ONLY marking: absolutely NO icon, NO pictogram, NO human figure, NO monogram, NO other words. Colour is glossy cool white with an extremely subtle pale blue tint, almost pure white.

mat_balasana.hook: 얼굴 안 보이는 뒷모습 - 매트 위 아기자세

The mat runs from the bottom of the frame to the top, its long axis pointing away from the camera, and the woman is positioned SQUARELY ON THE MAT AND ALIGNED WITH IT - her spine along the mat's centre line, head toward the far end, folded knees toward the near end. Plenty of empty mat surface visible in front of her hands and behind her feet. Warm minimal Korean apartment, pale oak floor, late afternoon sunlight raking in low from the left through a linen curtain.

The woman sits ON THE MAT with both legs folded, reaching one arm up and over into a seated side stretch, her head turned away and tipped down so her FACE IS OUT OF FRAME. Her whole body and both hands rest on the mat, nothing on the bare floor; the mat runs across the frame with generous empty surface visible at both ends. Warm minimal Korean apartment, pale oak floor, late afternoon golden light from the left.

band_flatlay.hook: 제품 정물(사람 없음) - 원목 바닥에 3종 플랫레이, 검정 라벨 노출

band_glute_bridge.hook: 얼굴 프레임 밖 - 매트 위 글루트 브릿지, 밴드 허벅지 착용

A GLUTE BRIDGE mid-exercise: she lies on her back ON A YOGA MAT, knees bent with both feet flat on the mat, HIPS LIFTED HIGH into a straight line from knees to shoulders, glutes squeezing, thighs pressing outward against the band; shoulders, upper back and arms stay grounded on the mat. ONE band is worn flat around BOTH THIGHS together, sitting squarely just ABOVE THE KNEES, perpendicular to the thighs and pulled visibly TAUT - it must wrap both thighs evenly, NOT diagonal, NOT twisted, NOT over one leg only, NOT slipping toward the hip. Bright side window light, warm minimal apartment, pale oak floor around the mat.

ONE band is worn flat around BOTH THIGHS just ABOVE THE KNEES, perpendicular to the thighs and visibly stretched by the lift - wrapping both thighs evenly, never diagonal or twisted. Soft window light, warm minimal apartment, pale oak floor around the mat.

mat_downdog.hook: 얼굴 안 보이는 옆모습 - 매트 위 다운독
mat_downdog.prompt: Side view at floor level, camera level with the mat and square to it. The woman is in ADHO MUKHA SVANASANA (downward-facing dog) seen entirely FROM THE SIDE: hands planted shoulder-width on the mat, hips lifted high, legs straight, body forming a clean inverted V. Her head hangs down between her arms so her FACE IS COMPLETELY OUT OF SIGHT. Because the camera is directly to her side, the pose reads as a clean triangular silhouette - NOT shot from behind, NOT angled toward the hips. SHE IS ENTIRELY ON THE MAT: both hands and both feet rest on the printed surface, nothing on the bare floor, her body aligned along the mat's length with empty mat visible in front of her hands and behind her feet. Warm minimal Korean apartment, pale oak floor, soft morning light from the window behind her.

band_side_step.hook: 하체만 - 밴드 착용 사이드 스텝, 허벅지 위
band_side_step.prompt: Fitness photograph, camera at knee height, square to the body. LOWER BODY ONLY - the frame is cut at the waist so the torso, head and face are COMPLETELY OUT OF FRAME. No twisting of the spine is visible at all. She stands in a shallow athletic half-squat with feet planted wider than hip width, knees tracking outward, pressing steadily against the band - a lateral band walk. TWO legs, TWO feet, natural realistic proportions, BAREFOOT. ONE band is worn flat around BOTH THIGHS together, sitting squarely just ABOVE THE KNEES, perpendicular to the thighs and pulled visibly TAUT by the outward pressure - wrapping both thighs evenly, NEVER diagonal, NEVER twisted, NEVER over one leg only, NEVER slipping toward the hip. Wardrobe: fitted charcoal-grey high-waisted leggings with a visible waistband seam and realistic stretch wrinkles. Photographic skin with visible natural texture. Warm minimal Korean apartment, pale oak floor, soft window light.

captions._caption_note: 톤: 시크하고 담백하게. '~잖아요/~거든요/~더라고요' 같은 수다체 금지, 이모지 금지. 짧은 단정문 2~4줄, 제품 설명보다 취향·공간·태도를 먼저 말한다. 본보기: '움직임에도 취향이 있으니까. 내 공간에 어울리는 나만의 홈트레이닝. 디자인짐.' brand_tail 은 한 주를 닫는 날(일요일)에만, 본문에 '디자인짐'이 없을 때 붙는다. 제품군별 최소 4개. 자세·구도를 지목하는 문구에는 angles 허용목록을 달아 그 앵글에만 걸리게 한다.

하루의 첫 동작은 매트를 펴는 일.

그 한 번으로 오늘의 리듬이 정해집니다.

빛이 가장 좋은 자리를 매트에 내줍니다.

운동은 그다음 이야기.

운동이 끝나도 접지 않습니다.

거실에 그대로 두어도 어색하지 않으니까.
치울 이유가 없으면 다시 서게 됩니다.

폭 61cm.

8mm.

band.c:
세 개가 한 세트인 이유.

강도가 다릅니다.
오늘의 컨디션에 맞춰 고르면 됩니다.

라텍스가 아니라 직물입니다.

맨살에 바로 걸쳐도 집히지 않고,
힘을 줘도 밀려 올라가지 않습니다.

눈에 보이는 자리에 둡니다.

보이면 한 세트 더 하게 되고,
보여도 지저분하지 않으니까.

무게를 늘리는 대신
저항의 방향을 바꿉니다.

같은 동작이 다르게 남습니다.

얇은데 두껍고,
부드러운데 팽팽합니다.

직물 밴드의 촉감.

쇠는 내려놓을 때마다 소리가 남습니다.

아파트에서는 그게 가장 신경 쓰이는 일.
이건 조용합니다.

오브제로 보이는 도구는
치울 이유가 없습니다.

4.5kg.

무겁지 않아서 매일 듭니다.
매일 드는 무게가 결국 가장 무겁습니다.

가운데 구멍이 손잡이입니다.

손을 넣는 방향만 바꾸면
스윙도 고블릿 스쿼트도 같은 도구로.

운동기구처럼 보이지 않는 것.

책과 화분 사이에 둡니다.

운동기구처럼 보이지 않아서

스무 번을 채워보면 답이 나옵니다.

set_terrazzo_window.prompt: Location: a bright corner of a hip Korean apartment. Pale terrazzo floor flecked with grey and rust. A chrome stool leg intrudes at one edge of frame, a glossy red ceramic cup sits on the floor, white wired earbuds lie coiled nearby, monstera leaf shadows fall across the ground. Light: strong direct daylight through a window out of frame, throwing HARD crisp-edged window shadows over everything.

set_oak_linen.hook: 오크 마루 + 리넨 커튼, 오후 빛
set_oak_linen.prompt: Location: a calm room in a hip Korean apartment. Light oak floorboards, a sheer linen curtain half drawn at one side, a slim aluminium side table, a tinted brown glass tumbler with water, a paperback left face-down on the floor. Light: afternoon daylight diffused through the linen on one side and falling hard and direct on the other, so the frame has both soft and crisp shadows at once.

set_concrete_loft.hook: 미장 콘크리트 + 검정 창틀, 대각선 빛
set_concrete_loft.prompt: Location: a stripped-back loft-style Korean apartment. Grey micro-cement floor, a black steel window frame, a brushed stainless water bottle standing on the floor, a grey marl sweatshirt tossed down in a heap. Light: late morning sun cutting through the steel frame, laying hard diagonal bars of light and shadow across the floor.

set_warm_evening.prompt: Location: a warm minimal Korean apartment late in the afternoon. Light oak floor, a matte ceramic mug half full, a folded waffle towel, a small trailing plant on the floor. Light: low golden sun coming in almost sideways, drawing long soft-edged shadows and catching dust in the air.

set_tile_bathlight.prompt: Location: a spare white-tiled room in a hip Korean apartment, grout lines running square to the floor. A slim black metal shelf edge at one side, a clear glass bottle of water, a rolled grey towel, a pair of white socks dropped on the floor. Light: cool early-morning daylight from a high window, flat and even with one hard-edged bright rectangle thrown across the floor.

set_rug_evening_lamp.hook: 러그 옆 저녁, 램프 하나 켜둔 방
set_rug_evening_lamp.prompt: Location: a lived-in Korean apartment in the evening. Warm oak floor with the corner of a nubby oatmeal rug at one edge of frame, a paper lantern floor lamp switched on out of frame, a ceramic cup and a phone face-down on the floor, a cardigan slung over a low chair. Light: one warm lamp low and to the side, so the product is lit from one direction and the far side of the frame falls into soft shadow.

ang_low_floor.prompt: Camera: phone held down near the floor, lens almost at ground level looking along the floor, so the product runs away from the viewer and the room falls off out of focus behind it.

ang_topdown_feet.hook: 탑다운 - 서서 내려다보며 내 발이 살짝
ang_topdown_feet.prompt: Camera: phone held at chest height pointing straight down at the floor. The photographer's own bare feet clip the bottom corner of the frame - no other person, no face, nothing above the ankles.

ang_three_quarter.hook: 허리 높이 사선 - 방이 함께 보이게
ang_three_quarter.prompt: Camera: phone at waist height, angled down at about forty-five degrees from one side, so the product sits off-centre and a slice of the room reads behind it.

ang_near_edge.prompt: Camera: phone low and close to ONE LONG EDGE of the mat, so that edge runs across the foreground and its thickness and dark edge band are clearly readable, while the rest of the mat recedes into the frame behind it.

ang_through_frame.prompt: Camera: shot from the next room, a doorway edge or a piece of furniture blocking part of the frame in the near foreground, the product small and off to one side - the look of noticing it on the way past.

ang_close_object.prompt: Camera: phone about thirty centimetres from the product, tilted down at it, the product filling roughly half the frame with the floor and props falling soft behind.

ang_in_hand.prompt: Camera: the photographer holds the product in their own hand at arm's length and shoots it with the other hand. Only a hand and forearm are visible - no face, no body, no second person.

ang_shadow_edge.prompt: Camera: framed so the hard edge of a window shadow cuts diagonally across the product, half of it in bright sun and half in shade, shot slightly off square.
